text: The meta is the Cherry deck. Scores differ by levels, runes, gear, Brightseeker/Milk stars and retries, not cookie choice.
detail: The Naver guide and the 1T 312G run field the same cookies and pets.

text: Levels steer Pomegranate's +69% beams: carries top the ATK order (Milk › Brightseeker › Skating Queen › Macaron › Tea Knight › Cheesecake), fillers sit at Lv.1.
detail: Scorpion holds 7th to catch stray beams. Order by ATK, not power, and check in battle: Octo Wasabi adds +8% when Scorpion enters.

text: Rank on damage, not on the 배 multiple. Pomegranate at Lv.1 doesn't add damage; it only lowers power and inflates the multiple.
Runes: Milk all ATK%; Brightseeker haste to 40–50 total with gear; Dark Choco haste; Pomegranate, Skating Queen, Macaron, Cheesecake, Tea Knight all skill amp.
Raid gear: weapons skill amp + crit dmg, top-right haste + skill amp, armour DR + HP, bottom-right haste + DR. No move speed, accuracy, focus or crit res.
Best documented run: 1T 999G with the plain Cherry deck, score on screen. Power unshown; the author's ~650× implies about 3.07G.
detail: Posted by DC user awkward2637, who also posted 섬영's lobby; crumb.gg lists the score as 섬영 (판도라).

text: Season 5's 2.3–3.2T leaders haven't published teams. Arithmetic closes most of the gap: about 3G at 650–780× is 2–2.3T.
detail: Power is necessary, not sufficient: 2.38G gave 1.07T (448×), 3G gave 1.3T (450×). The multiple comes from ATK order, runes and retries.

text: Season 5's jump from about 1.8T to 3.2T coincides with the first cookies surviving the 17 s wipe: about 9M HP and 45% DR each.
detail: Every public run up to 1.6T, and the #1 guild's 827.6G video, ends at the wipe. A timing match, not a shown build.

text: Among the Season 5 top 50, score tracks setup more than raw account power.
detail: Score ÷ account power: 75–143× (median about 100). Top power (30.0G) placed #24; #9 hit 2T 509G on 18.7G. Account-wide, so not the forum's 배.

text: Expect hours of retries: at about 1.7G, 500× lands 1 run in 5 and 1T 1–2 in 10. Records come from overnight macros.
detail: Retries buy little near a setup's ceiling: two hours got the 1T 999G author +16G on 9/19. His next record followed haste runes on Tiger Lily (dc:71121).
